versions.source: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual 8th Edition / NCCN / UICC
versions.provenance: 8th edition staging, verified against AJCC 8th edition / NCCN guidelines; licensed verification standard. Requires R1 clinical verification before unchecked use.
versions.introduction: Multiple myeloma is staged with the Revised International Staging System (R-ISS, 2015), which combines tumour burden (ISS: beta-2 microglobulin and albumin) with biology (high-risk cytogenetics and LDH). There is no TNM; this file maps R-ISS tiers onto the engine's T/N/M slots. High-risk cytogenetics are del(17p), t(4;14) and t(14;16) by FISH; LDH above the upper limit of normal upstages. Smouldering myeloma, solitary plasmacytoma and AL amyloidosis are classified separately.

t.label: Disease burden cannot be assessed (missing beta-2 microglobulin or albumin)
No evidence of active myeloma (MGUS/smouldering, not staged by R-ISS)
R-ISS I pattern: beta-2 microglobulin below 3.5 mg/L with albumin 3.5 g/dL or higher
R-ISS II pattern: neither stage I nor stage III
R-ISS III pattern: beta-2 microglobulin 5.5 mg/L or higher

n.label: Biology cannot be assessed (missing FISH or LDH)
High-risk cytogenetics [del(17p) and/or t(4;14) and/or t(14;16)] and/or LDH above normal

m.label: No end-organ (CRAB/SLiM-CRAB) attributable damage requiring therapy distinction; anatomic M does not apply
Extramedullary or plasma-cell leukaemia dissemination recorded as advanced biology (does not change R-ISS tier)

stageGroups.basis: ISS I plus standard-risk cytogenetics plus normal LDH
Neither stage I nor stage III
High-risk biology without full stage III burden
ISS III plus high-risk cytogenetics and/or high LDH

versions.regionalNodes: Myeloma has no regional nodal basins; N slots encode cytogenetic/LDH biology and M slots encode dissemination for engine compatibility. Lytic bone lesions, marrow plasmacytosis and free-light-chain ratio define active disease (SLiM-CRAB), not stage.
versions.histologicGrade: Plasma-cell morphology is not graded G1-G3; proliferation (plasma-cell labelling index), circulating plasma cells and cytogenetic risk stratify biology instead.
versions.histopathologicTypes: Symptomatic multiple myeloma (IgG, IgA, light-chain, non-secretory); smouldering multiple myeloma (not R-ISS staged); solitary plasmacytoma of bone or extramedullary; plasma-cell leukaemia.
prognosticFactors: Beta-2 microglobulin (below 3.5 vs 5.5 mg/L or higher)
LDH above upper limit of normal
R-ISS tier (I median survival not reached; III about 43 months in the original cohort)
Renal failure, anaemia, hypercalcaemia, lytic lesions (CRAB)
1q gain, del(1p) and TP53 mutation (extended risk)
